lines.en: Dan, the internet has been down for two hours. I called the provider, and they said that an outage had affected the whole street.
lines.pt: Dan, a internet está fora do ar há duas horas. Liguei para a operadora, e disseram que uma queda tinha afetado a rua toda.

lines.en: I wish we had a more reliable connection. The router was installed ten years ago, and it has never been replaced.
lines.pt: Queria que tivéssemos uma conexão mais confiável. O roteador foi instalado há dez anos e nunca foi trocado.

lines.en: The engineer told me that new routers are being delivered next week. He asked whether we wanted one.
lines.pt: O técnico me disse que roteadores novos estão sendo entregues na semana que vem. Perguntou se queríamos um.

lines.en: Of course! It is said that modern routers are twice as fast. I wish we had asked before.
lines.pt: Claro! Dizem que roteadores modernos são duas vezes mais rápidos. Queria que tivéssemos pedido antes.

lines.en: A hassle! My laptop was being updated when the signal dropped, and the update has been interrupted.
lines.pt: Que trabalheira! Meu notebook estava sendo atualizado quando o sinal caiu, e a atualização foi interrompida.

lines.en: It will be finished tonight, unless the problem continues. Meanwhile, read a book!
lines.pt: Ela será concluída esta noite, a menos que o problema continue. Enquanto isso, leia um livro!

lines.en: Very funny. I told my sister that I would send the photos today, but I had not uploaded them yet.
lines.pt: Muito engraçado. Falei à minha irmã que mandaria as fotos hoje, mas ainda não as tinha enviado.

lines.en: She will understand. It is believed that most people are used to delays like this. The more they happen, the less we mind.
lines.pt: Ela vai entender. Acredita-se que a maioria das pessoas está acostumada com atrasos assim. Quanto mais acontecem, menos ligamos.

lines.en: True, but I wish gadgets did not break down at the worst moment. Even my old speaker has been repaired twice.
lines.pt: Verdade, mas queria que aparelhos não quebrassem na pior hora. Até meu alto-falante velho já foi consertado duas vezes.

lines.en: Some of our devices have become obsolete. Cutting-edge technology is not cheap, but it is worth it.
lines.pt: Alguns de nossos aparelhos ficaram obsoletos. Tecnologia de ponta não é barata, mas vale a pena.

lines.en: You are right. Let us ask the provider if we can switch plans, provided that the contract is short.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Vamos perguntar à operadora se podemos trocar de plano, desde que o contrato seja curto.

work.title: O Conde de Monte Cristo
work.note: A referência é o romance da vingança, rancor e culpa. No romance de Alexandre Dumas, Edmond Dantès é preso injustamente, foge e dedica anos a uma vingança contra quem o traiu. A aula usa dois amigos conversando sobre quem guarda rancor e quem leva a culpa.

items.wrong: The router has replaced last year.
items.fix: The router was replaced last year.
items.why: The router receives the action: use was replaced. Last year takes the past simple.

items.wrong: I wish we have a faster router.
items.fix: I wish we had a faster router.
items.why: After wish, use the past simple for the present.

items.wrong: He asked me did I update it.
items.fix: He asked me whether I had updated it.
items.why: In reported questions, use if/whether and statement order.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: The router has replaced last year. → The router was replaced last year. | I wish we have a faster router. → I wish we had a faster router. | He asked me did I update it. → He asked me whether I had updated it..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.label: Revisão de tecnologia
facts.sub: Passivo: The router has been replaced. Wish: I wish we had a faster one. Discurso indireto: He asked whether we wanted one.

facts.label: Foi + feito
facts.sub: Passivo: The router has been replaced. It was installed ten years ago. It is being delivered next week. Foque na ação e no resultado, não em quem fez.

facts.label: Queria que…
facts.sub: Para o presente: I wish we had a faster router. Para o passado: I wish I had asked for one. Use passado depois de wish, nunca will nem presente.

compare.ask: I wish it had been repaired.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi consertado”, “queria que fosse” e “ele disse que”, sem pensar na gramática.
compare.tip: Diga: “I wish it had been repaired.”
compare.us: Em inglês, usamos passivo, wish + passado e discurso indireto.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The passive uses a form of be + past participle.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: We say “I wish we have a faster router”.
items.why: We say I wish we had a faster router.

items.s: Reported questions use if or whether.
items.why: Yes.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The passive uses a form of be + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I wish we have a faster router”. → Falso (We say I wish we had a faster router.)
Reported questions use if or whether. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Reported speech never changes the tense.
items.why: Tenses usually move back.

items.s: We can combine passives and wishes in one sentence.
items.why: Yes: I wish it had been fixed.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: Reported speech never changes the tense. → Falso (Tenses usually move back.)
We can combine passives and wishes in one sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes: I wish it had been fixed.)

pages.title: A night without internet · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold evening in a house in Calgary. Alma and Dan are sitting in the living room. The lights are on, but the internet is not. A small green light is blinking on the router. Alma is tired of waiting. She begins to complain.

“Dan, the internet has been down for two hours. I called the provider, and they said that an outage had affected the whole street.” says Alma. “I wish we had a more reliable connection. The router was installed ten years ago, and it has never been replaced.” says Dan. “The engineer told me that new routers are being delivered next week. He asked whether we wanted one.” says Alma.

Dan, the internet has been down for two hours. I called the provider, and they said that an outage had affected the whole street.

You
I wish we had a more reliable connection. The router was installed ten years ago, and it has never been replaced.

Alma
The engineer told me that new routers are being delivered next week. He asked whether we wanted one.
O técnico me disse que roteadores novos estão sendo entregues na semana que vem. Perguntou se queríamos um.
You
Of course! It is said that modern routers are twice as fast. I wish we had asked before.

Alma

You
